questions.question: The Parliamentary form of government is also referred to as the ______ model.

__
 
• **The Westminster model refers to the system of government in which the executive branch (prime minister and cabinet) is accountable to the legislature (parliament).**
 
• This model originated in the** United Kingdom** and has been adopted by many other countries, including India, Canada, and Australia.
 
• The term **"parliamentary" is used because the legislature plays a central role in the government**, with members elected by the people and responsible for making laws and holding the executive accountable.
 
• Other features of the **Westminster model include a strong two-party system**, a focus on the rule of law and individual rights, and a tradition of civil service neutrality and expertise.
 
• The Parliamentary System of government in India is taken from the British(UK)​constitution.
 
• The parliamentary system of government(PSA): 
 
 
• PSA means that the executive government branch of has the indirect or direct support of the parliament.
 
• This direct or indirect support is generally shown by a vote of confidence.
 
• The relationship between the legislature and the executive branch in any parliamentary system is called responsible government.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Theocracy** refers to a government **ruled by religious leaders, **which is not a form of parliamentary government.
 
• **Plutocracy** refers to a government ruled by the **wealthy,** which is not a form of government at all but rather a social system.
 
• **Communism** refers to a system of government in which p**roperty and resources are owned collectively by the people,** which is not a form of parliamentary government but rather a type of socialism.

• **Loans are a liability because they represent an obligation that has to be fulfilled by the borrower.**
 
• When a loan is taken, **the borrower receives funds that are recorded as a liability on the balance sheet, which needs to be repaid with interest within a specific period.**

• ** Liability:** A liability is an obligation that a company owes to another party, such as a loan or debt. Liabilities are recorded on the balance sheet and can be classified as current or non-current.

questions.question: Find the square of Z. Z is the remainder when the smallest 4-digit number is exactly divisible by 24 and 36 is divided by 40.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 24 and 36 = 72.

Smallest 4-digit number is 1000, and the nearest multiple of 72 is 72 × 14 = 1008.

Z = Remainder when 1008 is divided by 40.

1008 = 40 × 25 + 8 ⇒ Z = 8.

Square of Z = 8² = 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Smallest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 24 and 36.

Z is the remainder when this number is divided by 40.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 24 = 2³ × 3

⇒ Prime factorization of 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ LCM of 24 and 36 = 2³ × 3² = 8 × 9 = 72

⇒ The smallest 4-digit number is 1000.

⇒ 1000 ÷ 72 = 13 with a remainder of 64.

⇒ To find the smallest 4-digit multiple of 72, add (72 − 64) to 1000.

⇒ Required 4-digit number = 1000 + 8 = 1008.

⇒ Now, divide 1008 by 40 to find Z.

⇒ 1008 = (40 × 25) + 8

⇒ Thus, remainder Z = 8.

⇒ We need to find the square of Z.

⇒ Z² = 8² = 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

**__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest positive integer that is perfectly divisible by each of the given numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors present in the numbers.

Finding a Number Divisible by N in a Range

To find the smallest multiple of a number N greater than a base number B, use the formula: B + (N − Remainder of B ÷ N).

Remainder Theorem (Basic Division)

questions.question: A can complete a work in 15 days. A started the work alone and work for 4 days. B alone complete the remaining work in 18 days. In how many days will A and B together finish the work?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

A can complete the work in 15 days.

A worked alone for 4 days.

B completed the remaining work in 18 days.

**Concept: **

LCM & Work Efficiency calculation

Efficiency = Total Work / Days

**Solution:**

Consider the work as a whole, constitute it using LCM of 15 and 18 which is 90 units.

⇒ Efficiency of A = Total Work / Days = 90 units / 15 days = 6 units/day

In 4 days,

⇒ A will complete = 6 units/day × 4 days = 24 units

⇒ Remaining work = total work - work done by A = 90 units - 24 units = 66 units

⇒ B completes 66 units in 18 days, so B's efficiency = 66 units / 18 days = 3.67 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and B = 6 units/day + 3.67 units/day = 9.67 units/day

⇒ Time for A & B to complete the work together = Total Work / Combined efficiency = 90 units / 9.67 units/day = 9 (9)/(29) days.

**Therefore, A and B together will finish the work in approximately 9 (9)/(29) days**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 40 days and B can do the same work in 80 days. They work together for 20 days, how much of the work is left to complete?
questions.solution:

Work rate of A (Ra) = 1/40 work/day Work rate of B (Rb) = 1/80 work/day

Together, their combined work rate (Rc) is:

Rc = Ra + Rb = 1/40 + 1/80 = 1/40 + 2/80 = 3/80 work/day

If they work together for 20 days, the fraction of the work they complete (Wc) is:

Wc = Rc * t = 3/80 * 20 = 3/4 of the work

So if 3/4 of the work is complete, the fraction of the work left (Wl) is:

**Wl = 1 - Wc = 1 - 3/4 = 1/4 of the work is left to complete.**
